reasoning: Programmatic-only: 2 major concern(s): Lists converted incorrectly; Reading order significantly different

concerns.analysis: The source document contains nested lists under the 'Working Groups' section. Under 'NC Board on Geographic Names - Cam McNutt', there is a sub-item 'SMAC Discussion and Approval', which itself has two nested sub-items: 'Simone Mountain' and 'Stiles Mountain'. In the JSON output, these two sub-sub-items are incorrectly flattened. They appear as siblings of 'SMAC Discussion and Approval' in the same `children` array, rather than being nested underneath it, and the literal bullet characters ('▪')

o SMAC Discussion and Approval
▪ Simone Mountain
▪ Stiles Mountain

concerns.analysis: Evaluated the sequence of the extracted content against the visual flow of the PDF. The sidebar containing '2021 Meetings' and dates is located on the right margin of the page in the source PDF. In the output JSON, this sidebar text is inserted immediately after the 'Working Groups' introductory paragraph and before the bulleted list of those working groups. This interrupts the logical reading flow of the main text, separating the section heading/intro from its corresponding list items.
